quay_masonry.name: Quay masonry
quay_masonry.geometry: Load-bearing cut sandstone with deep beds, radial voussoirs at curves, drainage falls, thick reveals and individually readable repair inserts.

courtyard_infill.name: Courtyard infill
courtyard_infill.geometry: Recessed plaster infill held by a visible timber frame; modeled perimeter stops, timber joinery, lime capping and replaceable inset panels.

hanging_timber.name: Hanging timber
hanging_timber.geometry: Light open framing with diagonal tension braces, interlocking timber joints, bolted metal shoes and exterior service ledges; different section profiles from masonry.

civic_cast.name: Civic castwork
civic_cast.geometry: Cast mineral shell with ribbed rear stiffeners, recessed expansion joints, cast anchoring pockets and stepped modular returns; broad calm faces.
civic_cast.materials: ivory mineral composite; pale stone; brass

pressure_shell.name: Pressure shell
pressure_shell.geometry: Ribbed metal shell with welded flanges, gasket channels, rounded pressure corners, inspection covers and visible attachment points; retain external cladding as a separate layer.

workshop.name: Workshop made
workshop.geometry: Individually assembled construction: separate repairable body pieces, hand-fitted sections, exposed joinery or seams, replaceable fittings and a distinctive asymmetric maker silhouette.
workshop.materials: family palette with visible construction seams

concession.name: Concession standard
concession.geometry: A separately modeled manufactured design: pressed or molded main body, integrated grip or support profile, standardized closure or joint and replaceable service insert. Change silhouette and construction, not just marks or color.
concession.materials: family palette with standardized manufactured sections

open_service.name: Open service
open_service.geometry: Accessible surface installation with visible brackets, drip management, removable guards and reachable manual controls.

sealed_service.name: Sealed service
sealed_service.geometry: Pressure-rated enclosed installation with a different sealed housing, bolted access flange, captive fasteners, gasket seat and protected connector geometry.
sealed_service.materials: painted alloy; gasket rubber; ceramic; glass

authored.name: Authored form
authored.geometry: Individually authored silhouette and internal construction appropriate to the named form; neither a mirrored export nor a material swap.

countingPolicy: Only accepted geometric forms count as built. LODs, recolors, mirrored copies, placements, assemblies and destruction debris do not inflate this total.
